---
name: New data source
about: Suggest a website, API, or dataset OpportunityBox should pull opportunities from
labels: data-source
---

**Source name and link**

**What kind of opportunities does it list?**

Conferences, workshops, fellowships, grants, volunteer roles, calls for papers…

**How can the data be accessed?**

- [ ] Public API (link to docs:)
- [ ] Open dataset or repository (link:)
- [ ] RSS / iCal feed (link:)
- [ ] Only a normal web page (no feed)

**Roughly how many opportunities does it list, and how often does it change?**

**Anything else worth knowing**

Rate limits, terms of use, regions or fields it covers.

> If the source has no feed or API, the quickest route is adding entries to
> [`data/curated.json`](../../data/curated.json) in a pull request, see
> [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).
